QuestInfo.name: [Riena Strait] How About a Fish-Witch?
QuestInfo.1: #bBarbara#k recommended a fishing spot. Take your boat to the #bMiddle of the Strait#k and use #bBarbara's Fishing Kit#k.\r\n#r(You can get another fishing kit by #eforfeiting the quest#n and talking to Barbara again.)#k
QuestInfo.2: You took the boat to Barbara's fishing spot and used her fishing set to catch a big one.

0.0: Now, listen up. I need me some fat fishies to feed all my kiddies, and the ocean out here's still good n' clean despite that fat penguin's best efforts at messin' it up. Get out there and get me five before I toss ya out on yer rear.\r\n#i2431796##b#t2431796##k

yes.0: Don't be comin' back here with no small fries. I want those fishes big n' fat!\r\n#b#e(Use Barbara's Fishing Kit to catch 5 big fish from the ocean.)#k

1.0: Let me see how big they are. \r\n#i4030028##b#t4030028##k\r\n#i2431796##b#t2431796##k

yes.0: All right, ya bring in a good catch. Look at the little ones, all barkin' for a snack. C'mon my little darlin's! It's feedin' time!

item.0: Don't be comin' back here with no small fries. I want those fishes big n' fat!\r\n#b#e(Use Barbara's Fishing Kit to catch 5 big fish from the ocean.)#k
